Pre-analytical Correlation Analyses

Supplementary analyses examining whether specimen-level pre-analytical factors (fluid volume, QNS classification) are associated with assay output. Restricted to PIK3CA Multiplex valid tests.

Spearman correlations: fluid volume vs. wild-type droplet counts
PIK3CA Multiplex valid tests, stratified by specimen type
Comparison n Spearman ρ p-value
Cyst Fluid: Volume vs EXON 21 WT droplets 76 0.041 0.723
Cyst Fluid: Volume vs EXON 10 WT droplets 76 0.000 0.998
Blood: Volume vs EXON 21 WT droplets 31 0.475 0.007
Blood: Volume vs EXON 10 WT droplets 31 0.602 <0.001
Spearman rank correlation (non-parametric, distribution-free). Restricted to specimens with fluid volume > 0. Correlations not reported where n < 4.
Fluid volume: QNS vs. valid specimens
Mann–Whitney U test: p = 0.016
Result Category n Median Volume (mL) IQR Range
Valid 123 8.0 [5.0–10.5] 0.2 – 22.0
QNS 17 4.0 [3.0–8.0] 0.1 – 22.0
Restricted to specimens with recorded fluid volume > 0. Two-sided Mann–Whitney U test (Wilcoxon rank-sum). A lower median volume in the QNS group would suggest that low-volume specimens are at higher risk of failing the assay.
QNS rate by fluid-volume quartile
Cochran–Armitage trend test: p = 0.008
Volume Quartile n (Valid + QNS) QNS, n (%) Median Volume (mL)
Q1 (0.1–4.0 mL) 35 9 (25.7%) 3.0
Q2 (4.0–8.0 mL) 35 3 (8.6%) 6.0
Q3 (8.0–10.0 mL) 35 4 (11.4%) 9.0
Q4 (10.0–22.0 mL) 35 1 (2.9%) 14.5
Quartiles defined on the combined valid + QNS pool (n ≈ equal per bin). Trend test assesses whether QNS proportion decreases monotonically with increasing volume. Useful for setting a clinical minimum-volume recommendation.

Logistic regression: probability of QNS by fluid volume
Outcome: QNS (vs. Valid). Predictor: log₂(volume) ± specimen type

Volume only (unadjusted) 0.62 [0.42–0.89] 0.010

OR per doubling = multiplicative change in QNS odds per doubling of volume (e.g., OR = 0.50 means QNS odds halve with each doubling of volume; OR < 1 indicates protective effect). | Blood vs. Cyst Fluid (adjusted): OR = 2.96 [0.97–9.87], p = 0.061 | Restricted to Blood and Cyst Fluid specimens with volume > 0. | n = 140 (17 QNS, 123 Valid).

Missing data policy: All records with a valid Patient ID are retained (N = 160). For each analysis, only rows with valid (non-QNS, non-cancelled, non-blank) results are included. Blank result entries (N = 0) are excluded from all counts. Age and sex N reflect records with non-missing values only.
